modifications: Converted from TEI XML to plain text paragraphs with emphasis, with the long s printed as s. Each note opens with the words of the text it expounds as Jackson printed them, such as Vers. 2. And the earth was without form, and void.], and the notes after a labelled one stay with its verse. Sections are keyed by the verse labels printed at the start of the notes, such as Vers. 1. or V. 2., and a verse named inside a note is never read. A label misprinted between two that follow on is read as the number between them, and a label that cannot stand in its chapter's order, such as a repeated number, continues the section before it. A section runs from its own verse to the verse before the next section or the end of its chapter. The notes before a chapter's first label, such as an unlabelled note on the first verse or a psalm's title, are its verse 1. Every gap the transcribers could not key is kept as the mark they gave it, such as • for an illegible letter, 〈◊〉 for an illegible word, 〈 in non-Latin alphabet 〉 for Greek or Hebrew, and 〈1 page duplicate〉 for a page filmed twice. Line-end hyphens are closed up. In the third volume two pages are missing in Psalm 4, taking the heading of Psalm 5 with them; the notes that follow the gap are placed in Psalm 5 from verse 3, and the end of the title note on Psalm 5 stays at the end of the note on Psalm 4:4, where the transcription runs it on. Left out: the portraits, the title pages, the dedications, the prefaces to the reader, the errata, the bookseller's list, and the headings of books and chapters such as CHAP. I. The volumes have no notes on Exodus 37, and no volume covers Jeremiah to Malachi or the New Testament.
